objective: Build and validate the first immutable historical Top30 fixture and write-once assessment artifact.
prompt:
Read all canonical Stock Research Lab documents and prior audit results first.

Review especially:

- docs/historical-research-protocol.md
- docs/top30-observation-contract.md
- docs/audits/JOB-0006-point-in-time-leakage-audit.md
- docs/migration/legacy-inventory.md
- src/research_contracts/top30.py
- tests/test_top30_contract.py
- tests/test_historical_identity.py
- tests/test_point_in_time_leakage.py

Legacy reference repository:
D:/Project/stock-trading-system-reference

Treat the legacy repository as strictly READ ONLY.
Use local files only.
Do not use GitHub web requests.

ROLE

Implement the first small real historical fixture experiment while preserving
the point-in-time boundary established and hardened in JOB-0003 through
JOB-0006.

This is NOT a backtest and NOT an outcome study.

OBJECTIVE

Build a minimal pipeline:

historical source artifact
    ->
immutable byte-verified fixture manifest
    ->
Top30 parser/observation
    ->
historical identity resolution
    ->
AssessmentPayload
    ->
write-once frozen assessment artifact

No future price/outcome data may enter this job.

SCOPE

Use only a SMALL historical fixture set.

Prefer a small number of representative Top30 observations from one historical
cutoff/date, sufficient to exercise:

- a normally resolved identity
- an unresolved identity if available
- source provenance
- cutoff/availability semantics
- deterministic parsing and serialization

Do not process the full three-year history.

SOURCE ARTIFACT REQUIREMENTS

For every raw fixture artifact preserve:

- exact source bytes
- SHA-256 digest
- source identifier/reference
- source timestamp when known
- ingestion timestamp
- availability timestamp or explicit unknown state
- artifact type/format
- fixture provenance

Do not silently normalize or rewrite the source bytes before hashing.

If a reliable historical availability timestamp cannot be proven, represent
that uncertainty explicitly.

Do not invent historical timestamps.

IMMUTABLE FIXTURE MANIFEST

Implement a small deterministic manifest binding:

- fixture ID
- raw artifact path/reference
- byte length
- SHA-256 digest
- provenance
- source timestamp
- availability state/time
- parser/version information

Validation must fail if fixture bytes no longer match the manifest digest.

IDENTITY

Use the existing HistoricalIdentityBundle contract.

Do not use current KRX master data as historical truth.

If point-in-time evidence is insufficient:
- preserve source-observed name;
- leave identity unresolved.

Retrospective identity information may be stored only behind the existing
retrospective boundary and must not enter AssessmentPayload.

FROZEN ASSESSMENT ARTIFACT

Create a deterministic frozen assessment artifact for the fixture.

The artifact must bind at minimum:

- fixture/manifest digest
- cutoff
- observation identities
- assessment payload
- contract/schema version
- creation metadata
- deterministic content digest

WRITE-ONCE REQUIREMENT

A frozen assessment must not be silently overwritten.

If the same assessment ID/path already exists:

- identical deterministic content may be treated as an idempotent no-op;
- different content must fail loudly;
- never replace the previous frozen assessment.

The design must make historical rewrites visible.

DOWNSTREAM SAFETY

Unresolved observations must remain explicit in the frozen artifact.

Do not silently:
- drop unresolved rows;
- current-map them;
- guess codes;
- convert them to resolved rows.

NO OUTCOME JOIN

Do not load, compute, inspect, or attach:

- +5/+10/+20/+60 returns
- future OHLCV
- future sector performance
- future labels
- success/failure classification

This job freezes historical inputs and assessment only.

TESTS

Add tests proving at minimum:

1. raw fixture bytes match their stored digest;
2. byte modification causes manifest validation failure;
3. deterministic manifest serialization;
4. source/provenance metadata survives round trip;
5. unknown availability remains explicit;
6. unresolved identity survives the full fixture-to-assessment pipeline;
7. retrospective identity cannot enter the frozen assessment;
8. frozen assessment serialization is deterministic;
9. identical re-freeze is idempotent;
10. different-content overwrite is rejected;
11. frozen artifact binds to the correct fixture digest;
12. future/outcome fields are absent from the frozen artifact;
13. existing point-in-time adversarial tests continue to pass.

SECURITY / DATA

Do not commit secrets, credentials, API keys, Telegram credentials,
brokerage information, or account data.

Do not perform network acquisition in this job.

Do not modify the legacy repository.

DOCUMENTATION

Create:

docs/experiments/JOB-0007-historical-fixture.md

Document:

- selected fixture scope
- exact source provenance
- what was actually known at cutoff
- what remains unknown
- identity-resolution results
- manifest/digest design
- freeze semantics
- unresolved observations
- limitations
- whether the fixture pipeline is ready for a separate outcome experiment

READINESS VERDICT

End with exactly one:

READY_FOR_OUTCOME_FIXTURE
READY_WITH_RESTRICTIONS
NOT_READY

This verdict applies only to a small outcome fixture experiment,
not to the full three-year study.

QUALITY

Run the complete pytest suite.
Run git diff --check.

Keep implementation minimal.
Do not introduce a database, web UI, scheduler, or generalized artifact store.

Do not commit or push.

FINAL RESPONSE

Report:

- requested model tier
- actual model if runtime telemetry exposes it
- fixture selected
- source provenance
- files created/changed
- resolved/unresolved identity counts
- manifest/digest validation result
- frozen-assessment write-once validation result
- tests
- readiness verdict
- residual risks
- recommended next job
